title: Data Breach at O&M University in the Dominican Republic
description: O&M University of the Dominican Republic (udoym.edu.do) is an institution of higher education in the Dominican Republic founded in 1966. The following is an overview of key information from the website: Campus Locations (Recintos) The university has multiple campuses and colleges throughout the Dominican Republic, including: • Main Campus: Sede Central (located at 200 Avenida de la Independencia, Santo Domingo) • School of Medicine: Escuela de Medicina O&MED • Branch Campuses: East Santo Domingo, West Santo Domingo, Santiago, La Romana, Puerto Plata, Moca, San José de Ocoa Academic Programs (Oferta Académica) • Undergraduate (Grado): Covers Business Administration, Tourism and Hospitality Management, Architecture, Education, Social Communication, Accounting, Sports and Recreation, Law, Agricultural Engineering, Civil Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Systems and Computational Engineering, Medicine, Marketing, and Psychology (Clinical, School, and Industrial tracks), among others. • Technical Programs (Técnico): Advanced Technician in Agriculture (specializing in Crop Production). • Graduate Programs (Postgrado): Includes a Ph.D. in the Application of Artificial Intelligence to Business Productivity, as well as master’s and specialized programs in Accounting, Mathematics Education, Music Education, Educational Administration, Systems Engineering, Educational Technology, and Software Engineering.
